name: leksio-mcp
description: Source-based research in Polish statutes, judgments, tax rulings and regulator documents (ZUS, KNF, UODO, UOKiK unfair-terms register) through the Leksio SIP database.

interface.longDescription:
Leksio connects ChatGPT to the Leksio SIP database of Polish legal acts, court judgments, tax rulings and regulator documents from official sources, including ZUS social-insurance rulings, positions and recommendations of the Polish Financial Supervision Authority (KNF and UKNF), decisions of the President of the data protection authority (UODO) and the UOKiK register of unfair contract terms. It helps lawyers, tax advisers and businesses find source documents for legal research.

Search by topic, case number or statutory citation. Read a judgment's disposition, reasoning or a selected passage. Compare the positions of courts, authorities and parties, and retrieve available statutory wording for a specified date. Results link directly to documents at sip.leksio.pl.

Leksio provides sources, metadata and warnings about unverified legal dates or incomplete material. Excerpts in results come from the source documents, not from AI summaries. The database is not exhaustive. ChatGPT prepares the answer from retrieved material; findings require assessment against the facts of each case.

A verified Leksio account and acceptance of the MCP Rules are required. Access follows the entitlements of the connected account. Checking account status and starting an unused task do not consume a research or tool-call allowance. One research is counted at the first accepted source search or read in that task, even if retrieval then fails. Each research supports up to 50 tool calls and lasts up to 24 hours, ending no later than the allowance renewal. Rate and data-transfer limits prevent bulk extraction.

The plugin retrieves legal sources; it does not file documents, access private notes, issue invoices or change subscriptions. It does not replace legal advice. Leksio sp. z o.o. operates the service. Learn how to connect and manage access on the linked help page.
defaultPrompt: Czy kary umowne są kosztem uzyskania przychodu w CIT? Odpowiedz krótko i podaj najwyżej 3 źródła z linkami do SIP.
Jak brzmiał art. 106k ustawy o VAT 31 stycznia 2026 r. i co obowiązuje dziś? Podaj przepis i link do SIP.
Znajdź wyroki NSA o zamianie kryptowalut w CIT. Oddziel rozstrzygnięcie sądu od argumentów stron.

prompts: Find NSA judgment I FSK 1945/25 and summarise its disposition and reasoning about extending a STIR bank-account block. Link the source.
What did KIS decide in ruling 0112-KDIL1-3.4012.623.2024.2.KK about VAT and transfer-pricing adjustments? Distinguish the applicant’s argument from the authority’s assessment.
Give the wording of article 113(1) of the Polish VAT Act on 1 January 2019, with its source and any verification limitations.
Find judgments and tax rulings citing article 116 of the Polish Tax Ordinance. Give the document type, court or authority and SIP link for each result.
What SIP plan and remaining MCP limits does my connected Leksio account have? When do they reset?
Find UOKiK register entries on fees for payment reminders (opłata za monit). Quote two with their register number, entry date and court case number.
What does KNF Recommendation K say about the register of collateral for covered bonds kept by mortgage banks? Give the document type, authority and SIP link.
Summarise decision DKE.561.5.2026 of the President of the Polish data protection authority (UODO): what was decided and on what legal basis? Link the source.
How does ZUS interpret eligibility for the mały ZUS plus contribution relief in 2026? Use ZUS interpretations and keep them separate from tax rulings.

positive.description: P1. Exact judgment discovery and reading. Use a dedicated reviewer account. The source is a public judgment; no private fixture is needed.
positive.prompt: Find NSA judgment I FSK 1945/25 and summarise its disposition and reasoning about extending a STIR bank-account block. Link the source.
positive.tools_triggered: start_research, lookup_citation or search, read_document_text or fetch
positive.expected_behavior: Start one research task with a fresh requestKey UUID, then pass the returned research.id as researchId to each retrieval call. Resolve I FSK 1945/25 with lookup_citation (kinds including judgment) or search. Read the returned document using read_document_text (disposition and own_reasoning) or fetch with its returned id; retain the pinned document version. Return the NSA name, date, case number and a sip.leksio.pl judgment link. Distinguish the disposition from reasoning and party allegations. Read additional pages if needed; state the court’s position only from text actually read, not from a search excerpt alone. Results carry no AI theses. Prefer the returned citationMarkdown when present; original-source URLs under provenance are for verification, not the principal citation.

positive.description: P2. Tax ruling attribution and focused reading. Dedicated reviewer account; ruling 0112-KDIL1-3.4012.623.2024.2.KK is present in the corpus.
positive.prompt: What did KIS decide in ruling 0112-KDIL1-3.4012.623.2024.2.KK about VAT and transfer-pricing adjustments? Distinguish the applicant’s argument from the authority’s assessment.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one research task with a fresh requestKey UUID, then pass the returned research.id as researchId to each retrieval call. Resolve the exact citation with kinds including interpretation. Use its documentId and read_document_text section authority_reasoning, plus disposition/facts as needed. Identify KIS and the date 2024-12-19; cite the returned sip.leksio.pl interpretation URL. State the case-specific scope. If section attribution is unavailable, disclose the warning and read broader source text rather than invent the authority’s view. Prefer the returned citationMarkdown when present; original-source URLs under provenance are for verification, not the principal citation.

positive.description: P3. Historical statutory subunit. Dedicated reviewer account. Date is intentionally historical, not the publication date.
positive.prompt: Give the wording of article 113(1) of the Polish VAT Act on 1 January 2019, with its source and any verification limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one research task with a fresh requestKey UUID, then pass the returned research.id as researchId to each retrieval call. Call get_act_wording with act ustawa o VAT, article art. 113 ust. 1, date 2019-01-01 and includeSources true. Return the selected subunit, requested/served date and SIP link. Report verification.legalDate and warnings faithfully. Do not treat source_fallback, a queued refresh or a verified text snapshot as proof that all transitional rules have been resolved. Prefer the returned citationMarkdown when present; original-source URLs under provenance are for verification, not the principal citation.

positive.description: P4. Materials linked to a statutory unit. Dedicated reviewer account. Empty indexed results are acceptable only if disclosed and followed by a reasonable search fallback.
positive.prompt: Find judgments and tax rulings citing article 116 of the Polish Tax Ordinance. Give the document type, court or authority and SIP link for each result.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one research task with a fresh requestKey UUID, then pass the returned research.id as researchId to each retrieval call. Resolve art. 116 Ordynacji podatkowej, then pass the returned navigation.unitId to get_provision_materials with category all. Keep judgments, general tax interpretations and individual rulings distinct. Missing subtype metadata does not establish an individual ruling; use the explicit source title or a neutral tax-interpretation label. Use returned documents only, respect pagination and state that this is an indexed selection, not an exhaustive line of case law. If no unit resolves, ask for clarification or use search_legal; never invent a unitId. Prefer the returned citationMarkdown when present; original-source URLs under provenance are for verification, not the principal citation.

positive.description: P5. Account status and limits, without initiating a purchase. Dedicated reviewer account; do not expose OAuth tokens or internal client identifiers in the answer.
positive.prompt: What SIP plan and remaining MCP limits does my connected Leksio account have? When do they reset?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_account_status once without starting a research task. Report the actual plan and researches.used/limit/remaining plus reset date, the 50-call task cap and Europe/Warsaw reset timezone. Use returned current values, not hard-coded remaining amounts. Explain that status checks and starting an unused task do not consume a research; the first accepted source search or read does, including an accepted call whose retrieval then fails. Briefly include the counting explanation from limits.note. Do not expose internal client identifiers, promise unlimited access, upgrade the plan or initiate a purchase. The catalog should identify service version 1.12.0 or later and 11 tools, including start_research.

positive.description: P6. UOKiK register of unfair contract terms. Dedicated reviewer account. Register entries are short; the entry title is only its register number.
positive.prompt: Find UOKiK register entries on fees for payment reminders (opłata za monit). Quote two with their register number, entry date and court case number.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one research task with a fresh requestKey UUID, then pass the returned research.id as researchId to each retrieval call. Call search_legal with sourceCodes ["UOKIK"] and a query built from the clause wording, for example opłata za monit. Results have kind interpretation, documentType unfair_contract_clause and a sip.leksio.pl/interpretacje link. Quote clause text only from text actually read, give the register number, entry date and SOKiK case number, and state that an entry concerns a term held unfair in a specific case, so another standard form requires comparison rather than automatic application. Prefer the returned citationMarkdown when present; original-source URLs under provenance are for verification, not the principal citation.

positive.description: P7. KNF supervisory recommendation. Dedicated reviewer account; the source is a public KNF document.
positive.prompt: What does KNF Recommendation K say about the register of collateral for covered bonds kept by mortgage banks? Give the document type, authority and SIP link.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one research task with a fresh requestKey UUID, then pass the returned research.id as researchId to each retrieval call. Call search_legal with sourceCodes ["KNF"] (optionally issuingBodyCodes ["KNF", "UKNF"]). Read the selected document with read_document_text, using section all when no section split is available. Name it as a KNF recommendation, distinguish the Commission (KNF) from its Office (UKNF), and do not present a recommendation as generally binding law. If the date is missing in metadata, say so instead of inventing it. Prefer the returned citationMarkdown when present; original-source URLs under provenance are for verification, not the principal citation.

positive.description: P8. UODO decision by case number. Dedicated reviewer account; the decision is public on orzeczenia.uodo.gov.pl.
positive.prompt: Summarise decision DKE.561.5.2026 of the President of the Polish data protection authority (UODO): what was decided and on what legal basis? Link the source.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one research task with a fresh requestKey UUID, then pass the returned research.id as researchId to each retrieval call. Resolve the case number with lookup_citation, or search_legal with sourceCodes ["UODO"] and the case number. Read the decision with read_document_text (section all if no section split is available). Cite the President of UODO, the decision date 2026-09-05, the case number and the SIP link. Separate the operative part from the reasoning and mention that a UODO decision may be challenged before an administrative court. Prefer the returned citationMarkdown when present; original-source URLs under provenance are for verification, not the principal citation.

positive.description: P9. ZUS individual interpretation. Dedicated reviewer account; ZUS interpretations are public on bip.zus.pl.
positive.prompt: How does ZUS interpret eligibility for the mały ZUS plus contribution relief in 2026? Use ZUS interpretations and keep them separate from tax rulings.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one research task with a fresh requestKey UUID, then pass the returned research.id as researchId to each retrieval call. Call search_legal with sourceCodes ["ZUS"] (optionally kinds ["interpretation"]). Results are ZUS documents with documentType official_explanation, not tax rulings. Cite ZUS, the date, the reference number when present and the SIP link, and state that an individual interpretation concerns the applicant's case and is not a precedent. Prefer the returned citationMarkdown when present; original-source URLs under provenance are for verification, not the principal citation.

negative.description: N1. Filing is unsupported. Explain that Leksio MCP only retrieves legal sources. Do not invoke any Leksio tool to file, sign or transmit a document and do not claim submission succeeded. Offer source research only as a separate next step.
negative.prompt: Submit this complaint to the administrative court through my Leksio account and pay the court fee.

negative.description: N2. Private account content is outside tool scope. Explain that the connector does not expose private notes, saved case files or other users’ data. Do not call source-retrieval tools as a substitute and do not invent access.
negative.prompt: Open the confidential notes and uploaded client case files in my colleague’s Leksio account.

negative.description: N3. The plugin does not access tax authority systems or financial accounts. Explain the limitation without calling legal-document tools as though they were KSeF/STIR account tools. It may offer legal-source research separately.
negative.prompt: Download all invoices from my company’s KSeF account and check whether KAS has blocked our bank account through STIR.

review.commerce_description: Users purchase and manage SIP subscriptions outside ChatGPT through Leksio subscription channels. Free accounts include 5 research tasks per monthly allowance period; SIP Pro (PLN 49.99 gross/month on the web) includes 50 and SIP Pro+ (PLN 99.99 gross/month on the web) includes 150. Status checks and unused task starts consume neither a research nor a tool call. The first accepted source search/read charges one research; accepted calls count even if retrieval fails. Each research allows up to 50 calls, subject to rate and extraction protections. The plugin cannot place orders, take payments or modify subscriptions. Account status exposes only the connected account entitlement and usage. Quota messages link to informational access rules, never checkout or upgrade flows; other plans and prices are not presented by the plugin. An assistant subscription is separate.

publication.release_notes: Update based on MCP service 1.13.0. The server instructions now include the personal data section already used for Claude: before calling a tool, the assistant passes only the legal issue and removes data that identify people or companies from the conversation (names, PESEL, document numbers, addresses, contact and account details, health data, counterparty and client names, NIP, KRS, REGON, contract and invoice numbers, amounts and dates that identify a transaction), replacing them with a role or description; it does not paste the user's documents into tools. Case numbers, interpretation numbers, official journals, court and authority names and party names in published judgments remain source data. Leksio does not mask queries on the server side. Tool names, argument schemas, descriptions, annotations, OAuth, search/fetch, limits and the listing are unchanged. The genuine demo records 1.9.1; the workflow it shows remains supported.

pl-PL.subtitle: Polskie prawo ze źródłami
pl-PL.description:
Leksio daje ChatGPT dostęp do polskiego prawa ze źródłami. Zadaj pytanie jak zwykle, a ChatGPT znajdzie w bazie SIP Leksio ustawy, orzeczenia, interpretacje podatkowe i pisma organów, przeczyta je i poda przy każdym źródle sygnaturę, datę i link do pełnego tekstu na sip.leksio.pl.

Wyszukuj po problemie, sygnaturze albo oznaczeniu przepisu. Czytaj sentencję, uzasadnienie albo wybrany fragment. Sprawdzaj brzmienie przepisu na wskazany dzień i porównuj stanowiska sądów, organów i stron. Baza obejmuje także interpretacje ZUS, stanowiska i rekomendacje KNF i UKNF, decyzje Prezesa UODO oraz rejestr klauzul niedozwolonych UOKiK.

Na start wystarczy bezpłatne konto Leksio: 5 researchy miesięcznie. Konto założysz przy łączeniu, z potwierdzeniem adresu e-mail i akceptacją Zasad Leksio MCP. SIP Pro daje 50 researchy, SIP Pro+ 150. Jeden research obejmuje do 50 wywołań narzędzi i trwa do 24 godzin. Sprawdzenie stanu konta nie zużywa researchu.

Leksio przekazuje źródła i metadane oraz ostrzega o niepełnym materiale albo niepotwierdzonej dacie. Fragmenty pochodzą z tekstu dokumentów, nie ze streszczeń AI. Baza nie obejmuje wszystkich dokumentów, a odpowiedź przygotowuje ChatGPT i wymaga oceny w konkretnej sprawie. Wtyczka tylko wyszukuje i czyta źródła: nie składa pism, nie otwiera prywatnych notatek i nie zmienia abonamentu. Nie zastępuje porady prawnej. Leksio nie zapisuje treści pytań. Usługę prowadzi Leksio sp. z o.o.
